cases.description: Verify that a Base64 instance created with the default builder (which defaults to non‑URL‑safe encoding) returns false from isUrlSafe().
Verify that a Base64 instance built with `builder().urlSafe(true).build()` returns true from isUrlSafe().
Verify that a Base64 instance built with `builder().urlSafe(false).build()` explicitly sets the flag to false and isUrlSafe() returns false.
